parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under test-package directories — 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' and 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' — and the shared type name 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver' carries the canonical 'Mock' prefix, marking it as a test double. Although the pipeline emitted is_test=false and is_mock=false on both records (likely a flag-assignment gap), the file paths are literal evidence that these are test fixtures, not production types. Consolidating them into a shared target would couple two independent test packages (Metadata and app:iOS) through a shared mock dependency, which is an anti-pattern that makes test suites harder to isolate and evolve independently. If deduplication is desired, the correct action is to extract a shared test-support library (e.g., 'MetadataTestSupport') and re-evaluate at that time, but that decision belongs to the test-infrastructure owners, not this refactor pass.
